definitions.name: Create Workbook Session
definitions.documentation: Create Workbook Session: POST /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/createSession. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=CREATE_SESSION. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Get Worksheet
definitions.documentation: Get Worksheet: GET /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/worksheets/{worksheetId}. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Update Range
definitions.documentation: Update Range: PATCH /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/worksheets/{worksheetId}/range(address='{expression:address}'). Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=UPDATE_RANGE. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Delete Range Cells
definitions.documentation: Delete Range Cells: POST /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/worksheets/{worksheetId}/range(address='{expression:address}')/delete. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=DELETE_RANGE. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Merge Range
definitions.documentation: Merge Range: POST /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/worksheets/{worksheetId}/range(address='{expression:address}')/merge. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=MERGE_RANGE. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: List Tables
definitions.documentation: List Tables: GET /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/tables. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. definitions.name: Update Table
definitions.documentation: Update Table: PATCH /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/tables/{tableId}. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=UPDATE_TABLE. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Add Table Rows
definitions.documentation: Add Table Rows: POST /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/tables/{tableId}/rows/add. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=ADD_ROWS. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Update Table Row
definitions.documentation: Update Table Row: PATCH /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/tables/{tableId}/rows/{rowIndex}. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=UPDATE_ROW. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Add Table Column
definitions.documentation: Add Table Column: POST /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/tables/{tableId}/columns/add. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=ADD_COLUMN. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: List Named Items
definitions.documentation: List Named Items: GET /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/names. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests. definitions.name: Add Chart
definitions.documentation: Add Chart: POST /v1.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}/workbook/worksheets/{worksheetId}/charts/add. Requires explicit config.confirmWrites=true and config.confirmation=ADD_CHART. Externally issued delegated work or school OAuth token with Files.ReadWrite and access to the workbook. No application-only or personal-account session support, login or token refresh. Token from MICROSOFT_EXCEL_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret) or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken; profile options are RuntimeConnection.config. Session creation returns caller-visible id/persistChanges; every other operation requires sessionId. Persistent sessions save changes; nonpersistent sessions discard on expiration. Close explicitly; no hidden session creation, refresh, closure, transaction, rollback or replay. Exactly one bounded HTTPS request to graph.microsoft.com; redirects and 202 async responses rejected, retries zero. On any uncertain action reconcile workbook state before rerunning, including documented 504 cases. Total deadline begins before profile/secrets, default10s/max30s, request256KiB, response1MiB, URL16KiB, cleanup250ms. Page top/skip bounds1000/1000000; at most1000 results, nextLink returned as inert text and never fetched. Values/formulas require rectangular equal-shaped matrices, max10000 cells/1000 rows/columns and32767 chars per cell, no implicit reshaping. Excel can broadcast mismatched matrix versus target range; caller must choose matching range dimensions. Range output can contain null cell-level properties; null writes skip cells, empty string clears; formula evaluation is provider-side. Finite JavaScript numbers only, unsafe integers rejected; Excel uses about15 significant digits, use string literals for identifiers/exact decimals, no decimal fidelity promise. Explicit A1 range expressions escape apostrophes using OData doubling before strict percent encoding; opaque IDs reject raw/percent-decoded dot segments. Known provider fields projected; no arbitrary JSON/body/URL, automatic pagination, workbook download/upload, listeners or execution of external actions during builds/tests.
